messages:
customer-jane: Hey, streaming is dropping 'ghost' frames in production after we upgraded to ts-sdk v2.3.1. We get empty chunks mid-stream and the async iterator yields '' several times before resuming.

sara: @customer-jane sorry to hear that — can you paste a short log excerpt and the SDK method you call? Are you using EventSource or fetch-based streaming?

customer-jane: We use the TS browser SDK (node lambda) with EventSource fallback. Logs show pattern: partial text, empty line emitted, then more tokens. Sample from our logs:

```
[2026-03-16T15:02:11Z] stream-start id=abcd123
[2026-03-16T15:02:12Z] chunk: "Hello, can you"
[2026-03-16T15:02:12Z] chunk: ""   <-- empty chunk
[2026-03-16T15:02:12Z] chunk: " please confirm"
[2026-03-16T15:02:12Z] end-stream
```

Also noticed token rotation around the same time (we rotate short-lived keys every 60s). We suspect auth refresh racing with SSE reconnect.

matt: @customer-jane thanks — that empty chunk looks like an SSE keepalive or heartbeat being surfaced as an empty payload. Which transport does the SDK pick (EventSource vs fetch)? The SDK logs usually say.

customer-jane: SDK logs: `transport=eventsource` and `autoResume=true`. We see occasional 502s from the edge preceded by `401` during rotation.

eng-mike: this could be two separate things: 1) heartbeat/keepalive frames accidentally emitted as data events to the iterator, 2) a resume branch that replays a zero-length delta while re-syncing seq nums. Can you share a minimal repro? Browser or node?

customer-jane: node 18 lambda. Minimal repro snippet we used:

```
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const stream = client.responses.stream({ model: 'open-llm', input: 'hi'.repeat(100) });
for await (const part of stream) {
  console.log('part:', JSON.stringify(part));
}
```

When running locally with `rw-key` rotation simulated (curl to rotate) we hit empty part strings 1/20 runs.

sara: Can you attach the header traces? Particularly `x-rw-seq` or `x-rw-stream-id` if present. Also include the full SDK user-agent string.

customer-jane: headers from connection:

```
:status 200
x-rw-stream-id: stream-7b9
x-rw-seq: 102
x-rw-transport: eventsource
x-rw-server: edge-4
user-agent: rw-ts-sdk/2.3.1 node/18
```

Then later after rotation:

```
:status 401
:reason TokenExpired
```

followed by reconnect and a `:status 200` with stream resume and `x-rw-seq: 103` then the empty chunk.

eng-mike: thanks. Could you also capture raw SSE lines? I want to see if there's an event like `event: heartbeat` or `data:` with empty payload. On our side, we recently changed the heartbeat to send a `\n` line to keep proxies alive which might be parsed incorrectly by the TS iterator.

customer-jane: pasted raw SSE below (sanitized):

```
data: {"delta":"Hello, can you"}
\n
data:
\n
data: {"delta":" please confirm"}
\n
event: done
```

sara: Aha. That `data:` blank line is being forwarded as an empty data frame — iterator yields '' since SDK treats any data event as content. We should ignore zero-length data frames at parse time. @eng-mike can you check parser change in 2.3.1?

eng-mike: On it. Quick check: parser was updated to be more permissive to support upstream proxies that split lines. Bug introduced where blank `data:` lines are not filtered. I'll try a patch to drop empty data events. Also need to ensure resume logic doesn't emit an empty synthetic delta when seq gaps are small.

support-bot: Ticket #INC-4721 created and assigned to eng-mike. SLA: 48h.

customer-jane: Thanks. One more thing — we're seeing duplicate billing increments when the client receives an empty part, then reconnects and the server resends overlapping tokens. Billing team flagged repeated token counts.

matt: That matters. If resume path replays overlapping tokens without dedupe marker, we'll double-count. @eva from billing, can you weigh in on how we measure tokens for resumed streams?

eva: Token counting occurs at finalization. We log per-stream token deltas on `event: done`. However if a resumed stream calls done twice for overlapping content we may double count. We'll need a server-side de-dup window keyed by `x-rw-stream-id` + seq.

eng-mike: For now, quick mitigation: filter out empty `data:` frames in SDK and server will add an `x-rw-resume-from` header to indicate resume seq. I'll open two PRs (sdk patch + server-side resume dedupe) and link here.

customer-jane: Any ETA? We have production hits but low frequency. If we can get a patch that only ignores empty frames in SDK that would reduce customer impact.

eng-mike: I'll push an SDK patch to 2.3.2 within today and a server fix on the main branch tomorrow. Can you test candidate 2.3.2 pre-release? I'll post a tarball.

sara: We'll also add an instrumentation flag to log when empty data frames are received so we can measure incidence rate.

customer-jane: Happy to test. Also can we have a beta key that doesn't rotate so we can isolate auth effects?

matt: Yes — @support-bot can you generate a non-rotating key for customer-jane (48h)?

support-bot: Generated ephemeral key: rw_test_nonrot_48h_XXXXX (posted to DM)

customer-jane: Got it, testing now. Running 2000 requests with non-rotating key -> 0 occurrences of empty chunk in 2k runs. With rotating key 60s -> ~1.9% occurrence.

eng-mike: That strongly indicates the race with token rotation triggers the server to emit a blank data frame during resume. SDK fix still useful but we need server resume robustness.

sara: Thanks everyone. Action items:
- eng-mike: SDK patch to ignore empty data frames and publish 2.3.2 (ETA: today)
- eng-mike/server: resume dedupe + `x-rw-resume-from` header (ETA: tomorrow)
- eva: add server-side de-dup window for billing counts (ETA: 72h)
- support: give customer-jane 48h non-rotating test key (done)
- customer-jane: verify 2.3.2 and report results

eng-mike: Uploaded SDK pre-release 2.3.2-beta. Link: https://internal-packages/redwood/ts-sdk/2.3.2-beta

customer-jane: Installing... quick test shows 0/1000 runs with empty part. Will run longer test and report back.

sara: Great. If you hit any regressions ping here. We'll keep this thread open until server dedupe is in.

customer-jane: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround :thank_you:

matt: marking status: investigating -> fix-deployed (SDK), server in progress.

support-bot: Incident INC-4721 updated: sdk-patch-deployed."
